question: Should this protected security-scanner CI hardening land once the required checks complete?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proof-positive, but repository policy reserves items carrying the protected `security` label for explicit maintainer handling.

options.title: Land after checks
options.body: Approve the bounded download pattern after required checks finish, accepting the successful live PR-diff scan plus identical full-scan coverage.

options.title: Request full-scan proof
options.body: Ask for a manual full-scan workflow run before landing if separate live execution of both workflow files is required.

recommendation.title: Land after checks
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded download pattern after required checks finish, accepting the successful live PR-diff scan plus identical full-scan coverage.
